free_tier.stated: No free inference allowance is stated. GET /v1/models returns a public catalog without a key; with a key it lists the models the workspace may call, at per-million-token prices.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible base URL with an sk-inco- key; OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages are supported
chaining: the workspace key and per-token prices bind; model discovery itself is public

limits.value: per-million-token prices in the catalog; an empty balance returns 402 credit_balance_exhausted
per-minute rate limit and monthly workspace spend limit; a 429 carries Retry-After for the rate limit

identity_cost.detail: create a key on the API keys page for a workspace; no free inference allowance is stated

reliability_note: a stream cut at its one-hour limit is billed for the output sent; workspace spend limits reset on the 1st UTC; relayed models may be unavailable in some countries

evidence.proved: GET /v1/models returns a public catalog without a key; workspace model access and prices require a key
evidence.quote: Without a key it returns the public catalog; with your key, it lists the models your workspace may call, at its prices.

notes: no standing free inference allowance is published; model discovery is public but calls require a key and a funded workspace
